Definition
[acceleration of a curve]

Source: petersen:page-0187, petersen:page-0188

For a $C^\infty $ curve $c:I\to M$ the acceleration is $\ddot c=\frac{d^2c}{dt^2}$. In local coordinates, \[ \ddot c=\frac{d^2c^k}{dt^2}\partial _k+\frac{dc^l}{dt}\frac{dc^j}{dt}\Gamma ^k_{lj}\partial _k. \]
